title: Redpoll
blurb: The redpoll is a species of small passerine bird in the finch family Fringillidae. It is the only species placed in the genus Acanthis.
facts: It breeds in the Arctic and north temperate Holarctic tundra and taiga.
The redpoll was formerly widely treated as three species: the common or mealy redpoll, the arctic or hoary redpoll, and the lesser redpoll.
